description.value:
Fast Crafting with Leatherworker's Tools (Crafter feat, D&D 2024).

  • You need the Crafter feat and proficiency with Leatherworker's Tools.
  • When you finish a long rest, you can craft one item of this list, without cost.
  • The item lasts until you finish another long rest, then it falls apart and is removed.
